title: Roadmap Contract
description: Normalized internal model produced by parsing a ROADMAP.md file. Used for audit, scoring, and orchestration.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the roadmap contract schema used to produce this record.

repoName.description: Short name of the repository this contract was derived from.

repoPath.description: Absolute local path to the repository, if available.

roadmapPath.description: Absolute local path to the ROADMAP.md file, if available.

roadmapState.description: Top-level classification of the roadmap's actionability.

maturityLevel.description: Maturity classification based on roadmap structure and completeness.

maturityScore.description: Numeric weighted score (0–100) that was used to derive the maturity level.

pendingCount.description: Total number of unchecked checklist items across all sections.

completedCount.description: Total number of checked checklist items across all sections.

totalCount.description: Sum of pending and completed checklist items.

nextPendingItem.description: The first unchecked checklist item found in document order.

text.description: Text of the checklist item, stripped of leading markup.

section.description: Name of the heading section in which the item appears.

sections.description: All sections parsed from the roadmap, in document order.

pendingItems.description: Unchecked checklist item texts within this section.

completedItems.description: Checked checklist item texts within this section.

hasProductIntent.description: True if the roadmap contains a recognizable product intent or scope section.

hasReleaseSections.description: True if the roadmap uses release-scoped headings (e.g. 'Release X.Y').

hasAcceptanceCriteria.description: True if at least one release section includes acceptance criteria.

hasOutOfScope.description: True if at least one release section includes an out-of-scope boundary.

parseError.description: Human-readable description of why parsing failed, or null if parsing succeeded.

auditFindings.description: List of audit rule findings produced when auditing this contract.

ruleId.description: Stable identifier for the audit rule that produced this finding.

scoreImpact.description: Points deducted from the maturity score due to this finding.

parsedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this contract was produced.
